// Reports a confirmed failure (nothing external was published) so Infidash can retry the job.
let job=null;try{job=$('Validar trabajo').first().json.job;}catch(e){}if(!job||!job.leaseToken){try{const input=$('Trabajo recibido').first().json;job=input.job??input;}catch(e){}}const failure=$input.first()?.json??{};const raw=failure.error??failure;const detail=typeof raw==='string'?raw:(raw?.message??raw?.description??failure.message);const message=String(detail??'Fallo generando los posts de redes').slice(0,4000);if(!job?.id||!job?.client_id||!job?.leaseToken)throw new Error('Trabajo sin leaseToken; no se puede informar a Infidash: '+message);return [{json:{schemaVersion:1,clientId:job.client_id,status:'failed',error:message,result:{workflowVersion:1,stage:'generate_rrss'},leaseToken:job.leaseToken,jobId:job.id}}];
